description: Na₅LiMn₂O₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five MnO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 99°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent MnO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent MnO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 42°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.57 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.84 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.60 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.85 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.94 Å. Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four MnO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-1.97 Å. There are three inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O atoms to form MnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.73 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O atoms to form MnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-73°. There are two shorter (1.71 Å) and two longer (1.73 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O atoms to form MnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids and corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.72 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) Mn-O bond length. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Mn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 9°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Mn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Mn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 9°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one Mn atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, and one Mn atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Mn atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Mn atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, and one Mn atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mn atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Li, and one Mn atom.
